scope: Fresh independent seeds after the frozen 100k screen; validate centered, minimum-core theta=0, and theta=.25 input decompositions with two-quadrature classical noise. theta=0 is minimum pure-core squeezing; theta=1 is maximum core squeezing. Same Gaussian target for each theta in exact arithmetic. Joint PNR finite simplex plus full remaining tail; no photon cutoff in the sampler. Dimension-free McDiarmid upper bound plus target tail; lower bound uses an event selected on the first half and tested on the second half. Nominal bounds assume ideal IID draws and exact numerical targets, not formal finite-PRNG/interval certificates. Parameter selection requires a separate holdout run.
